name: SY1
author: fenderberg
tagline: A polysynth with 500 included Synth1 presets
description: SY1 turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a two-oscillator virtual-analog polysynth with Synth1's 99 parameters: it loads .sy1 patches sent over USB, and every parameter can be edited on the FM-1 itself. Includes 500 community factory presets without using the 1,024 user slots. Explore 3,174 community presets in the website Patch Manager or import your own banks locally.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp. The parameter laws are oxo_synth2's measurements of Synth1 (MIT, Francois Chabloz). Not affiliated with Daichi Laboratory.
